prompt: Bring my water bottle from the desk to the couch

task.prompt: Bring my water bottle from the desk to the couch

design.summary: A 4WD Raspberry Pi robot equipped with a high-reach linear actuator arm and servo gripper to fetch the water bottle from the desk and drop it at the couch.

reasons.pi4b-4gb: Provides processing power and GPIO connectivity to control all robot sub-systems.
reasons.chassis-4wd-m: Offers sufficient deck height and weight capacity to support the heavy linear actuator arm.
reasons.arm-lact10p: Lifts up to 2000g and provides the necessary vertical extension to reach the 760mm high desk.
reasons.tool-gripper: Grasps and holds the water bottle during transport.
reasons.servo-pca9685: Provides PWM control signals for the servo-driven gripper tool.
reasons.md-tb6612: Drives two motor channels for drive wheels and linear actuator operation.
reasons.bat-nimh-2200: Delivers 7.2V power with high current capacity for extended runtime.
reasons.reg-5v-3a: Steps down the 7.2V battery voltage to a steady 5V at 3.2A to reliably power the Raspberry Pi.
